## Technical analysis (Friday July 3, 2026 — KST session complete; US closed)

**KST confirmed session:** Open ₩2,665,000 (+15.8% gap from ₩2,301,000 July 2 close). High: ₩2,723,000 (ADR underwriter ceiling). Low: ₩2,502,000 (intraday test of stop zone, recovered). Close: ₩2,552,000 (+10.88%, +₩251,000). The session structure is a classic post-crash gap-up with partial fade: opened at the squeeze extreme (₩2,665,000), ran to ADR underwriter ceiling (₩2,723,000), faded into the afternoon on short-covering exhaustion, closed at ₩2,552,000 — above the mandatory stop threshold by ₩12,000 with meaningful but declining volume into the close.

**Stop Day 1 isolated — protocol reset:** The ₩2,552,000 KST close exceeded the ₩2,540,000 mandatory stop threshold, ending the Stop Day 1 / Stop Day 2 binary sequence that began with July 2's ₩2,301,000 close. The two-consecutive-close protocol requires CONSECUTIVE closes below ₩2,540,000 — July 3 broke the sequence. Stop protocol resets: a new Stop Day 1 can only be triggered by a FUTURE KST close below ₩2,540,000.

**Candle structure:** The July 3 session formed a bullish gap-up hammer / shooting-star hybrid — extremely long upper shadow (₩2,665,000 to ₩2,723,000 = ₩58,000 upper wick) with a moderate lower shadow (₩2,552,000 to ₩2,502,000 = ₩50,000 lower wick) and a close in the lower half of the range. This is NOT a clean bullish engulfing — it is a squeeze-and-fade pattern that signals the mechanical covering catalyst has been exhausted. July 6 will determine whether real buying conviction follows the mechanical event.

**Pattern — squeeze-reversal in distribution context:** July 2 was a -10.96% gap-down crash (distribution); July 3 was a +10.88% gap-up squeeze (short-covering). The net two-session move is: ₩2,584,000 (July 1 close) → ₩2,552,000 (July 3 close) = -₩32,000 (-1.24%). Two sessions of extreme volatility have NET ZERO'd — the stock is exactly where it started before the Apple/CXMT event, minus ₩32,000. This is NOT a bullish reversal — it is a volatility normalization that has reset the stop clock.

**Volume analysis:** ~5.1M shares estimated — second-highest of the ADR run-up period. Heavy volume on the gap-up session confirms institutional participation (not just retail covering), but the fade from ₩2,723,000 to ₩2,552,000 on sustained volume suggests selling pressure at the ADR underwriter ceiling is real. Volume 'confirming' the gap-up but also the fade is a mixed signal.

**Gate progress:** KOSPI 8,088.34 (Gate 1: >8,500; gap = 411 pts, 5.1%). SK Hynix ₩2,552,000 (Gate 2: ₩2,700,000; gap = ₩148,000, 5.8%). Both gates require additional sessions of positive performance to clear. At today's rate, KOSPI needs ~1 more +5% session and SK Hynix needs ~1 more +6% session — both simultaneously. The buy-side VI sidecar at 1:47 PM KST shows today's KOSPI velocity was at the upside limit — consecutive sessions of this magnitude are rare.

**★ Key risk — ADR underwriter ceiling vs Gate 2 convergence:** The ADR underwriter's confirmed selling ceiling at ₩2,723,000 is only ₩23,000 above Gate 2 (₩2,700,000). This means the full-size add signal (Gate 2 clearance) may require breaking through the underwriter's management ceiling. Watch for underwriter ceiling to shift upward as listing date approaches and ADR offering price is finalized — if they set the ADR price above ₩2,700,000 (equivalent in USD), the ceiling should lift.

**Decision points:** (1) ₩2,552,000: current close — defend or lose in July 6 session. (2) ₩2,540,000: stop threshold — any KST close below triggers a new Stop Day 1. (3) ₩2,700,000 + KOSPI 8,500: simultaneous gate clearance required for full-size add. (4) ₩2,723,000: ADR underwriter ceiling — first resistance on any continuation rally.
